{{Quote|She used data we forwarded to pinpoint exactly where the Esh-kha tapped into the teleporter control system. Forwarding the coordinates now.|Devlin|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Transporter Control Center''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vault located in the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], that hosted the control mechanisms for the [[teleporter]]s throughout the Tomb. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] attempted to tap into the teleportation system by seizing the control center, but were defeated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Transporter Control Center appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Republic mission "Prison Repairs."<ref name="TOR" />
